description: Constructed recovery-time stress experiment for the fixed-cabinet record queue. Duration weights are illustrative and have not been fitted to repair records.
information_rule: At minute 8 the original schedule's inspection prefix has been committed; the roster of new orders and the fact of a review-desk shutdown are observed. Commit once to a complete suffix under a stated repair-duration prior. The actual recovery minute is hidden until service resumes. Do not reroute again.
